items.claim: Raphael Tobias has really solid grappling and nasty submission skills.
items.quote: really, really solid grappling, nasty submission skills

items.claim: Raphael Tobias's wrestling is not the best, but he can push opponents against the fence and take them down.
items.quote: wrestling not the best, but you know, can push you up against the fence, take you down

items.claim: Raphael Tobias has power on the feet, but his striking is very, very sloppy.
items.quote: on the feet, I mean, he's got some power, but it's very, very sloppy.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has a solid ground game and has shown the ability to defend takedowns and use grappling offensively.
items.quote: Lucas's ground game is solid? We've seen him be able to defend takedowns. We've seen him use his grappling very well offensively.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando throws good technical sharp straight punches with a jab right down the middle and no telegraph.
items.quote: he throws good technical sharp straight punches, man. That jab is right down the middle. There's no telegraph on it.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando works the body incredibly well.
items.quote: He works the body incredibly well.
